figure_candidates.label: Figure 2
figure_candidates.caption:
Fig. 2 | Genomic features of P. chienii. a Pictures of a wild P. chienii tree used for
genomic DNA sequencing. b Circos plot of P. chienii genome. Track Ⅰrepresents the
length of the chromosomes (Gb); Ⅱand Ⅲrepresent GC content and gene density,
respectively; Ⅳ-Ⅵrepresent gene expression without or with MeJA treatment,
respectively; Ⅶ-Ⅸshow the distribution of transposons, Gypsy, and Copia LTRs,
respectively. These features were calculated in 10 Mb windows. Center, the syntenic
regions were linked by curve lines. c Analysis of insertion time based on the total
LTR. d Analysis of insertion time based on different types of LTR. e Venn diagram
